implementation: Actual Vue with verified history-window synchronization; template and review CSS unchanged; no production CSS import
scope: Fixture-intercepted GET only; no real API, MySQL, RBAC, full history/KeepAlive, OS clipboard or production acceptance. Browser history uses a synthetic same-route entry; copy uses a local success/rejection adapter. Real dashboard GET writes view and audit records.
